text: つかれてる　みたいよ！

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.span: つかれてる　みたい
patterns.explanation: みたい after a phrase means 'it looks like' or 'it seems'. つかれてる みたい = 'you seem tired'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, which here shows the state you are in now. つかれてる = 'are tired'.
